test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL - English (Held On : 11 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Smooth
solution: The correct answer is '**Flat**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Smooth**' is '**Flat**'. • **Smooth**: having a completely flat surface with no lumps or holes or rough areas. [चिकना (पूरी तरह से समतल सतह वाला, जिसमें न कोई गूमड़ या गाँठ हो न कोई छेद न खुरदरापन)] • *Example: **smooth** skin...* • **Flat**: smooth and level, with no parts that are higher than the rest. [(सतह आदि) सपाट, समतल] • *Example: The countryside in Essex is quite **flat** [there are not many hills]* **Correct Answer:__** *Flat.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Uneven**: not completely smooth, level or regular. (छोटा-बड़ा, असमान, ऊबड़-खाबड़, खुरदरा, असमतल) • **Broken**: damaged or in pieces; not working. (टूटा हुआ, खंडित; बेकार, ख़राब, चालू हालत में न होना) • **Rough**: not smooth, soft or level. [खुरदरा (चिकना, कोमल या समतल नहीं)] 36:T82c, The erroneous part is **'The recently hike'.**
